name: Qwen 3.8 27B
short: Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 27B dense open-weights model (27B, 262K/1M YaRN) for agentic coding and vision; GPQA 90.5%, SWE-bench 86.0% (Vals).
pricingNote: Open weights (Apache-2.0): self-hosting free, API provider pricing varies
standout: A dense open-weights model that punches far above its size on agentic coding and vision, and costs nothing to run when self-hosted.
tradeoff: At 27B dense it leans on context-extension tricks for very long inputs, and frontier-depth reasoning still belongs to its larger siblings.
